verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own MCP server at developers.pomelo.la/mcp, with install instructions for Cursor (one-click button or manual steps) and documented tools that search endpoints and generate request code samples, so an agent can connect to an official MCP server. The documented tools only cover API discovery and code generation, not live account or card operations. Setup is evidenced only for Cursor. missing for 10: documented tools for live API operations, setup steps for agent clients other than Cursor, details on auth and transport, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Para instalar nuestro MCP en Cursor, puedes hacer clic en el botón a continuación o seguir los pasos manualmente.
Devuelve los endpoints que coincidan con una consulta específica en español o inglés.
Genera un ejemplo de código para realizar el request al endpoint.
official MCP server documented at https://developers.pomelo.la/mcp
